gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: Everyone says she takes ___ her grandmother.
gaps.explanation: take after a relative = resemble them in character/looks.

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: The gang gave ___ the stolen paintings to a gallery.
gaps.explanation: give away = give free of charge, or reveal (a secret).

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.
